Dear candidate,

Thank you for your application for the Python BackEnd Developer position. We will not move forward with your application because your CV does not meet two required criteria: at least 5 years of software development experience, and experience with asynchronous programming and performance-critical applications.

This decision was prepared with an automated system. You have the right to request a human review of this decision (GDPR Art. 22): simply reply to this message.

Kind regards
